title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer for Elliptic Curve 143a1 — Formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formalization for the elliptic curve 143a1, including the class number of ℚ(√−143), rank, and BSD formula components. This repository is part of David Fox's Opera Numerorum ensemble.
